## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 197 captures during March 2022. Capture activity continued across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

There were 5 ungradable image sets. The ungradable rate was 2.5 per cent. This indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. The result should continue to be monitored through routine review of image capture and session arrangements.

## Grading

A total of 40 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 18 days. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for results to progress through grading during March 2022. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading figures give a summary of operations at Central Eye Clinic for the reporting month.
